changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to canonical forms (Transformer, M2M-100). Removed languages only mentioned in examples (French, Spanish). Simplified output description. Added Korean and Vietnamese which are explicitly used in experiments.

Removed NUM and MATCH which are minor metrics mentioned only in appendix. Kept BLEU (which uses SacreBLEU implementation) and CONSIST as the main metrics. Simplified CONSISTθ to CONSIST for consistency.
No LLM-based evaluation is used in this paper. The models mentioned are for translation generation, not evaluation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations are automatic metrics-based.

overall_notes: This paper focuses exclusively on Machine Translation robustness evaluation using automatic metrics. The extraction was mostly accurate but needed normalization of model names and trimming of minor metrics. The paper uses only automatic evaluation (BLEU and CONSIST metrics) with no human or LLM-based evaluation.
